items.title: Vince Giordano interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2007
items.q: Marty Grosz occasionally calls me and John Booker. And we’ve driven to Cincinnati to play a gig

ctx.x: So it could have been somewhat worse. So right now, what do you do? Do you find it necessary to do other things with keeping the music alive as much as you can?

Yeah. I freelance with other different groups, Marty Grosz occasionally calls me and John Booker. And we’ve driven to Cincinnati to play a gig, I mean that’s as crazy it is, even though I live in New York — the capital of the world — doing the BMG gig was eight years and that was a neat little day gig and then working nights and weekends. At this point most of my bills are paid and I’m not working as much as I’d like to be working but like I said my big drive is to really try to get this idea of a club in New…
